description:
This video is brought to you by Crystals of Irm, an old-school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawler elements. – https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971470/Crystals_Of_Irm/

In today's episode, J & Ludo dive into what it takes to make a game look "real" and how its pursuit may lead to drastically ballooned development times.
